name: VehicleDeliveryHandoverPlanner
tagline: Every vehicle handover planned, prepared and signed off – bay schedule, PDI-to-payment readiness checks, EV handover checklist and customer rating in one Power Apps component.
description: A complete handover app for dealers and dealer groups: a bay-and-slot schedule with double-booking rules where appointments are dragged to another bay or time with a reason; seven readiness checks per car (PDI, valet, registration, accessories fitted, documents signed, payment cleared, insurance confirmed) with a preparation deadline; a readiness board from To book to Handed over; a prep checklist matrix for the workshop, valeting and accounts teams; and a handover checklist that adds charging items for electric cars, with customer sign-off and a 1–5 rating. Works with demo data the moment it is dropped on a canvas screen, a model-driven form or dashboard, or a Power Pages page.
features: 10 KPI tiles: today's handovers and bay utilisation, next 7 days and readiness, ready, not ready in time, payment not cleared, date passed, bay conflicts, to book, handed over, customer rating
Bay schedule: bays × handover slots, drag to move with a reason, + to book a free slot, To book side list, week view
Booking dialog with the free slots of the chosen bay and the delivery executive
Seven readiness checks with n/a for accessories, optional checks and a preparation-days deadline
Ready only when every required check is done and the VIN is recorded; re-opening a check moves the car back to In preparation
Handover checklist with configurable items plus EV / PHEV charging items
Customer sign-off with name, 1–5 rating and comment; low ratings flagged for a call-back
Appointment confirmation generated from a template – CustomerMessage for Outlook, Power Automate or SMS
Bulk tick, status, assign, export and delete with Undo; search, filters, grouping, sorting, paging
Low-code data connection: Items data set with 30 column mappings, model-driven direct save, Power Pages Web API control
Power Fx outputs (selection, KPIs, changes, messages) and events OnSelect, OnChange, OnCreate, OnSave, OnAction, OnStatusChange
Phone, tablet and desktop layouts, keyboard and screen-reader support
